headline: Central Bank of Ireland to Cut Financial Pre-Vetting Roles by 60%
summary: The Central Bank of Ireland plans to reduce the list of financial sector roles requiring pre-approval vetting by 60% after an external review found the regime overly broad.
why: Ireland is a major hub for European fund management, banking subsidiaries, and international insurance providers.

impacts.name: Ireland
impacts.why: Regulatory requirements for executive financial pre-approval are being reduced.
